verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a Payment Links feature for accepting payments on any channel via shareable links, but the pricing model is explicitly sales-led with no self-serve signup rate card, and there's no evidence of a truly no-code, instant self-serve signup flow for founders (account approval/underwriting is implied by the sales-led pricing). missing for 10: hands-on/independent evidence of self-serve signup and instant activation without a sales conversation, screenshots or walkthrough of the dashboard link-creation flow, and confirmation there's no merchant approval delay before selling.
